ALL_ROWS.description: Optimizes a statement block with a goal of best throughput, that is, minimum total resource consumption.

APPEND.description: Uses direct-path INSERT if your database is running in serial mode.

CACHE(table-name).description: Places the blocks retrieved for the table at the most recently used end of the LRU list in the buffer cache when a full table scan is performed.

CLUSTER(table-name).description: Uses a cluster scan to access the specified table.

CURSOR_SHARING_EXACT.description: Executes the SQL statement without any attempt to replace literals with bind variables.

DRIVING_SITE(table-name).description: Executes the query at a different site than that selected by the database.

DYNAMIC_SAMPLING(table-name integer).description: Controls dynamic sampling to improve server performance by determining more accurate predicate selectivity and statistics for tables and indexes.

FACT(table-name).description: Makes the table specified in tablespec a fact table in the star transformation.

FIRST_ROWS(n).description: Optimizes an individual SQL statement for fast response, choosing the plan that returns the first n rows most efficiently.

FULL(table-name).description: Performs a full table scan for the specified table.

HASH(table-name).description: Uses a hash scan to access the specified table.

INDEX(table-name index-name).description: Uses an index scan for the specified table.

INDEX_COMBINE(table-name index-name).description: Uses a bitmap access path for the table. If index-name is omitted, the optimizer uses whatever Boolean combination of indexes has the best cost estimate for the table.

INDEX_FFS(table-name index-name).description: Performs a fast full index scan rather than a full table scan.

INDEX_JOIN(table-name index-name).description: Uses an index join as an access path.

INDEX_SS(table-name index-name).description: Performs an index skip scan for the specified table.

LEADING(table-name, ...).description: Uses the specified set of tables as the prefix in the execution plan.

MERGE(v).description: Lets you merge views in a query.

MODEL_MIN_ANALYSIS.description: Omits some compile-time optimizations of spreadsheet rules -- primarily detailed dependency graph analysis.

NOAPPEND.description: Uses conventional INSERT by disabling parallel mode for the duration of the INSERT statement.

NOCACHE(table-name).description: Places the blocks retrieved for the table at the least recently used end of the LRU list in the buffer cache when a full table scan is performed. This is the normal behavior of blocks in the buffer cache.

NO_EXPAND(table-name).description: Does not consider OR-expansion for queries having OR conditions or IN-lists in the WHERE clause. Usually, the optimizer considers using OR expansion and uses this method if it decides that the cost is lower than not using it.

NO_FACT(table-name).description: Makes the table specified in tablespec not a fact table in the star transformation.

NO_INDEX(table-name index-name).description: Does not use one or more indexes for the specified table.

NO_INDEX_FFS(table-name index-name).description: Excludes a fast full index scan of the specified indexes on the specified table.

NO_INDEX_SS(table-name index-name).description: Excludes a skip scan of the specified indexes on the specified table.

NO_MERGE(table-name).description: Does not combine the outer query and any inline view queries into a single query.

NO_PARALLEL(table-name).description: Overrides a PARALLEL parameter in the DDL that created or altered the table.

NO_PARALLEL_INDEX(table-name index-name).description: Overrides a PARALLEL parameter in the DDL that created or altered the index, thus avoiding a parallel index scan operation.

NO_PUSH_PRED(v).description: Does not push a join predicate into the view.

NO_PUSH_SUBQ.description: Evaluates nonmerged subqueries as the last step in the execution plan. Can improve performance if the subquery is relatively expensive or does not reduce the number of rows significantly.

NO_PX_JOIN_FILTER(table-name).description: Prevents the optimizer from using parallel join bitmap filtering.

NO_REWRITE.description: Disables query rewrite for the query block, overriding the setting of the parameter QUERY_REWRITE_ENABLED.

NO_QUERY_TRANSFORMATION.description: Skips all query transformations, including but not limited to OR-expansion, view merging, subquery unnesting, star transformation, and materialized view rewrite.

NO_STAR_TRANSFORMATION.description: Does not perform star query transformation.

NO_USE_HASH(table-name ...).description: Excludes hash joins when joining each specified table to another row source using the specified table as the inner table.

NO_USE_MERGE(table-name ...).description: Excludes sort-merge joins when joining each specified table to another row source using the specified table as the inner table.

NO_USE_NL(table-name ...).description: Excludes nested loops joins when joining each specified table to another row source using the specified table as the inner table.

NO_XML_QUERY_REWRITE.description: Prohibits the rewriting of XPath expressions in SQL statements.

ORDERED.description: Joins tables in the order in which they appear in the FROM clause. (Tip: Use the LEADING hint, which is more versatile than the ORDERED hint.)

PARALLEL(table-name integer).description: Uses the specified number of concurrent servers for a parallel operation.

PARALLEL_INDEX(table-name index-name int.description: Uses the specified number of concurrent servers to parallelize index range scans for partitioned indexes.

PQ_DISTRIBUTE(table-name outer-distr inn.description: Affects how to distribute rows of joined tables among producer and consumer query servers. Can improve the performance of parallel join operations.

PUSH_PRED(v).description: Pushes a join predicate into the view.

PUSH_SUBQ.description: Evaluates nonmerged subqueries at the earliest possible step in the execution plan Can improve performance ff the subquery is relatively inexpensive and reduces the number of rows significantly.

PX_JOIN_FILTER(table-name).description: Forces the optimizer to use parallel join bitmap filtering.

QB_NAME.description: Defines a name for a query block. This name can then be used in a hint in the outer query or even in a hint in an inline view to affect query execution on the tables appearing in the named query block.

REWRITE.description: Rewrites a query in terms of materialized views, when possible, without cost consideration. Use this hint with or without a view list

STAR_TRANSFORMATION.description: Uses the best plan in which the transformation has been used.

UNNEST.description: Unnests and merges the body of the subquery into the body of the query block that contains it, allowing the optimizer to consider them together when evaluating access paths and joins.

USE_CONCAT.description: Transforms combined OR-conditions in the WHERE clause of a query into a compound query using the UNION ALL set operator.

USE_HASH(table-name ...).description: Joins each specified table with another row source using a hash join.

USE_MERGE(table-name ...).description: Joins each specified table with another row source using a sort-merge join.

USE_NL(table-name ...).description: Joins each specified table to another row source with a nested loops join, using the specified table as the inner table.

USE_NL_WITH_INDEX(table-name index-name).description: Joins the specified table to another row source with a nested loops join using the specified table as the inner table.
